shadshiny

shadshiny brings the shadcn/ui design system to Shiny. It is a from-scratch port — 59 accessible, themeable components rebuilt in framework-free CSS and vanilla JavaScript, then wrapped as ordinary R functions with native Shiny input bindings.

  • No build step, no npm, no React. Components are plain htmltools tags backed by a single bundled asset dependency.
  • Native Shiny inputs. Read values with input$id; drive them from the server with update_shad_*(). Modules and renderUI() just work.
  • Coexists with Bootstrap 5 / bslib. Dark mode keys off the same signals bslib::input_dark_mode() uses, so theme sync needs zero glue.
  • OKLCH token theming. Seven presets out of the box, switchable at runtime.

shadshiny is an independent reimplementation. It ships no shadcn/ui or Radix source — only visually-compatible CSS/JS written for this package. See Attribution.

Installation 

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("orijitghosh/shadshiny")

Quick start 

library(shiny)
library(shadshiny)

ui <- page_shad(
  theme_preset = "violet",
  shad_card(
    shad_card_header(
      shad_card_title("Create account"),
      shad_card_description("Enter your details below.")
    ),
    shad_card_content(
      shad_input("email", label = "Email", type = "email",
                 placeholder = "you@example.com"),
      shad_select("plan", label = "Plan",
                  choices = c(Free = "free", Pro = "pro", Team = "team"),
                  selected = "pro"),
      shad_checkbox("tos", label = "I accept the terms")
    ),
    shad_card_footer(
      shad_button(inputId = "submit", "Sign up", variant = "default")
    )
  ),
  verbatimTextOutput("out")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$out <- renderPrint(
    list(email = input$email, plan = input$plan, tos = input$tos)
  )
  observeEvent(input$submit, {
    if (!isTRUE(input$tos)) {
      shad_toast_error("Please accept the terms.")
    } else {
      shad_toast_success(paste("Welcome,", input$email))
    }
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

Run the flagship demo covering every component:

shad_run_example("kitchen-sink")

Components

Tier 1 — display & typography

shad_button shad_badge shad_avatar shad_card
shad_alert shad_separator shad_skeleton shad_spinner
shad_aspect_ratio shad_label shad_progress shad_breadcrumb
shad_table shad_kbd shad_code typography (shad_h1…shad_p)
shad_item shad_empty shad_button_group

Tier 2 — form inputs

shad_input shad_textarea shad_checkbox shad_switch
shad_radio_group shad_toggle shad_toggle_group shad_slider
shad_select shad_native_select shad_combobox shad_input_otp
shad_calendar shad_date_picker shad_form_field shad_input_group

Tier 3 — overlays

shad_dialog shad_alert_dialog shad_sheet shad_drawer
shad_popover shad_tooltip shad_hover_card shad_dropdown_menu
shad_context_menu shad_menubar shad_command shad_toast

Tier 3 — navigation & structure

shad_tabs shad_accordion shad_collapsible shad_pagination
shad_scroll_area shad_resizable shad_carousel shad_navigation_menu
shad_sidebar_layout

Chat / AI kit

shad_message shad_bubble shad_attachment shad_marker
shad_message_scroller

Every stateful component is namespaced-module safe and has a matching update_shad_*() server helper where it holds a value. Overlays add shad_<name>_open() / shad_<name>_close().

Theming

Colours are OKLCH --shad-* custom properties — never hard-code hex. Pick a preset at page level or swap it live:

page_shad(theme_preset = "green")            # slate stone blue green rose violet orange

# server-side, e.g. from a shad_select + shad_switch toolbar
update_shad_theme(preset = input$preset, dark = input$dark)

Dark mode is driven by .dark / [data-bs-theme="dark"], so bslib::input_dark_mode() toggles shadshiny components with no extra wiring. See vignette("theming").

Attribution

shadshiny is inspired by and visually compatible with shadcn/ui (MIT) by shadcn, which itself builds on Radix UI primitives. No upstream source code is vendored. All CSS and JavaScript in this package were reimplemented from scratch to be framework-free and Shiny-native. shadcn/ui and Radix are trademarks of their respective owners. shadshiny is released under the MIT License.
